# BEGIN Nubamia redirects
Redirect 301 /privacy-policy/ /politica-privacidad/
# END Nubamia redirects

# BEGIN WordPress

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
	RewriteEngine On
	RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
	RewriteBase /
	RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
	RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
	RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
	RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>

# END WordPress

</IfModule>
